title: refactor(enter): simplify account and dashboard content
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Organizes Account into profile, connected apps, support and deletion cards, with copyable support emails. Keeps account deletion disabled after success.
- Clarifies key permissions and model selection, keeps new secrets visible when the key-list refresh fails, and makes confirmation dialogs compact on narrow screens.
- Keeps loading inside titled cards and avoids sign-in loading flicker. Preserves the quest load → automatic check → reload flow and reload after claims; simplifies News, connected-app and recent-event fetching, and restores FAQ URL hashes.
- Preserves the merged model catalog from #15369 and consolidates model/agent title links without changing its design or destinations. Uses optional connected-app descriptions and shared light-mode action-button fills.
- Validation: 103 pricing/catalog/query tests, 2 integrations tests, Enter typecheck, frontend build and formatting passed locally. Review also covered responsive layouts and error/retry flows. Preview files are locally excluded; fixtures are not committed.

Shared button/dialog changes affect other UI package consumers. The separate session-refresh secret-loss edge is tracked in #15401.

gist.headline: The dashboard got a garden path
gist.blurb: The Enter dashboard has been gently rearranged so the important bits stop hiding behind each other. Account details, API key controls, quests, and loading states now have clearer little homes.
gist.summary: Refactored the Enter account and dashboard UI into clearer account cards, improved API-key permission and model selection flows, resilient secret visibility, compact mobile dialogs, and more reliable loading, quest, news, and FAQ navigation behavior.
gist.impact: Users get a calmer dashboard: support emails can be copied, new API secrets remain visible if a key-list refresh stumbles, permissions and models are easier to understand, and pages load within their own titled cards without sign-in flicker.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful garden keeper reorganizing a cozy dashboard garden into labeled beds for Profile, Connected Apps, Support, API Keys, and Quests. A CRT monitor robot can hold a neatly labeled key card while small code-plants grow from the sections, representing clearer navigation and resilient UI states.

Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, with dark purple (#110518) pixel outlines and subtle CRT glow.
